what_it_is.prose: Larsen & Toubro's Counter Drone System (CDS) is listed on the official L&T Precision Engineering and Systems (L&T PES) Electronics Products and Systems / Command & Control System product page. The system comprises a radar, RF detector, RF and GNSS jammer systems, EO tracking system, and an optional hard-kill effector (laser-based Directed Energy Weapon or air defence gun-based system) integrated via a centralized Command & Control system with open architecture. No detection range figures, indigenous content percentage, deployment records, or procurement orders have been found in public sources. The L&T Manthan Drone Demo Day held in Bengaluru in August 2026 was an internal startup showcase, not a procurement event. The 'V1' label used in the Atlas should be treated as an editorial designation; L&T PES does not publish a version number.

deployments_procurement.summary: No public procurement or deployment records for the L&T PES Counter Drone System have been found. The system is listed on the official L&T PES product page but no customer has been named. L&T's defence order book exceeds ₹20,000 crore (per LinkedIn indicative sources) but the counter-drone share is not separately disclosed.
